terra.problem: “It has belonged to the kings of Judah ever since” goes beyond 1 Samuel 27:6, which says it belonged to them “to this day”—the time of the account. Use that wording instead.
The line says David lived at Ziklag “while he waited to become king,” but the cited accounts do not describe his stay that way. “While he was away from Saul” would stay closer to the passages.
The title “Ziklag burned and taken” could suggest the Amalekites occupied the city. The passage says they burned it and carried its people away. Consider “Ziklag burned and its people taken.”
